item.title: Gain Speaking Confidence with Mare Island Toastmasters — Thu Nov 19, 7:30 PM
item.description:
We meet in-person only on the 1st and 2nd Thursdays of the month. However, you can catch us online every Thursday unless the meeting date falls on a holiday.
Please register at https://signup.com/go/WiniixA
What is Toastmasters About?
Usually at our meetings, we will have a prepared speech, and a speech evaluation. The Grammarian and Wizard of Ah's will listen for turns of phrases and the use of filler words. We also practice impromptu speaking during the section of the meeting called Table Topics. During Table Topics, at a recent meeting, we were asked what we felt was the biggest communication problem or challenge. What would you answer in a fast moment? Table topics will challenge you to think quickly and give an answer without preparation.
You will also hear tips on public speaking skills at our upcoming meeting. Whether you're a seasoned traveler or just looking for some adventure from the comfort of your home, this event is perfect for you.

item.title: Join Mare Island Toastmasters and Learn Speaking Tips and Tricks — Thu Nov 19, 7:30 PM
item.description:
Do you want to learn some tips to improve your communication skills? Will you give a speech at an upcoming meeting or event? Toastmasters can help. Please join us weekly online \(except holidays\). We only have a hybrid meeting \(in-person and online only the 1st and 2nd Thursdays of the month.
Join us for a fun filled, fast paced meeting at 7:30pm Pacific Time.
Toastmasters can:
1. help you communicate with confidence,
2. help you improve listening skills,
3. help improve your feedback skills, and
4. improve your impromptu speaking skills, and more.
The 3 main parts to the meeting are:
\*\*Prepared Speech
\*\*Impromptu Speaking
\*\*Evaluation
Usually, we have a meeting theme for each meeting. At the meeting, we help one another grow and improve our communication and leadership skills. We are a part of Toastmasters international, which is a non-profit organization.

item.title: Sonoma Garden Park Volunteer Workday | Dia de trabajo voluntario cada tercer viernes del mes — Fri Nov 20, 9:00 AM — Sonoma Garden Park
item.description:
\[Español abajo\]
Every 3rd Friday of the month from 9:00 am to 12:00 pm we welcome existing and new volunteers for a fun morning of work and community building at Sonoma Garden Park. Depending on the season activities include prepping fields, planting, harvesting, weeding, pruning trees and prepping produce for the seasonal Saturday Harvest market.
Join us for a fun opportunity to enjoy the bounty of each season, and to share and learn from other gardeners. Existing and new volunteers are encouraged to attend—no experience is necessary! Please be sure to bring your gardening gloves, hat, SPF and water. At noon you enjoy a light garden fresh lunch at our shady picnic area provided by Sonoma Ecology Center as a thank you to our wonderful volunteers!

item.title: Gain Speaking Confidence with Mare Island Toastmasters — Thu Nov 26, 7:30 PM
item.description:
We meet in-person only on the 1st and 2nd Thursdays of the month. However, you can catch us online every Thursday unless the meeting date falls on a holiday.
Please register at https://signup.com/go/WiniixA
What is Toastmasters About?
Usually at our meetings, we will have a prepared speech, and a speech evaluation. The Grammarian and Wizard of Ah's will listen for turns of phrases and the use of filler words. We also practice impromptu speaking during the section of the meeting called Table Topics. During Table Topics, at a recent meeting, we were asked what we felt was the biggest communication problem or challenge. What would you answer in a fast moment? Table topics will challenge you to think quickly and give an answer without preparation.
You will also hear tips on public speaking skills at our upcoming meeting. Whether you're a seasoned traveler or just looking for some adventure from the comfort of your home, this event is perfect for you.

item.description:

The Harvest Market is a great place to pick up produce, flowers, and eggs harvested from our 6.1 acre sustainable garden. We will be selling products such as fresh produce, eggs from free-range chickens, honey, and olive oil. The market now accepts credit cards. Remember to bring your reusable shopping bag!
